CapabilityIdentity.description:
An owner-qualified, version-pinned capability identity.

[`CapabilityName`] is registry-local, so durable references use this pair
whenever a surrounding record does not already pin the owning registry.
The serialized owner is an auditable claim, not authentication or proof
that the capability is registered.

CapabilityReference.description:
A version-pinned reference to a registered capability.

Names are unique only within their owning registry. Durable provenance must
therefore pair this value with the owning principal or registry identity.

PrincipalIdentity.description:
The stable external identity of an authenticated principal.

OIDC guarantees uniqueness and stability only for the issuer/subject pair.
Tenant boundaries remain separate and must still be included in storage
keys and authorization decisions.

notice.description: Exact description text bounded to 16384 UTF-8 bytes. StateKnot additionally rejects boundary whitespace, disallowed controls, bidi formatting controls, and Unicode noncharacters at runtime. Shape validation does not establish descriptor trust.

FailureCategory.description: Stable semantic category shared by component-specific errors.

oneOf.description: A caller-supplied value failed validation.
Authentication was absent or invalid.
The authenticated principal lacked a required permission.
A policy explicitly denied the operation.
A visible resource was not found.
Current state conflicted with the requested transition.
The requested operation or capability is unsupported.
A rate or quota limit prevented execution.
The operation exceeded its deadline.
Cancellation was requested or observed.
A required dependency was temporarily unavailable.
Durable or transported data failed integrity validation.
An external side effect may have occurred but cannot yet be proven.
An internal invariant or implementation failed.

FailureDetails.description:
Schema-bound, resource-limited structured information safe to expose.

The schema reference gives adapters an explicit mapping contract. The value
is revalidated under limits tighter than general [`BoundedJson`] values.
Enclosing transports must also cap the raw error body because generic Serde
cannot account for insignificant whitespace outside this value.

value.description: Any JSON value. StateKnot enforces byte, depth, container-entry, node, string, object-key, duplicate-key, and finite-number constraints at runtime; JSON Schema alone cannot express those aggregate limits.

RetryAdvice.description:
Explicit recovery advice supplied by the originating component.

Retryability is never inferred from [`FailureCategory`]. A scheduler must
still intersect this advice with idempotency, deadline, budget, attempt,
circuit-breaker, and policy constraints.

oneOf.description: Do not automatically retry this operation.
A new attempt is semantically safe no earlier than the stated delay.

delay.description: Minimum delay before a scheduler may begin a new attempt.

oneOf.description: Determine the external outcome before choosing retry or compensation.

SchemaReference.description:
An immutable reference to canonical JSON schema bytes.

The explicit version supports compatibility policy, while the digest
prevents a reused URI or version from silently changing validation
behavior.

message.description: A public-safe single-line message bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. StateKnot additionally rejects leading/trailing whitespace, controls, bidirectional formatting controls, Unicode line separators, and Unicode noncharacters at runtime. Shape validation cannot prove that the caller omitted secrets.

ToolErrorPhase.description:
Stage at which one physical tool attempt failed.

Phase is observation evidence only. It never implies retry safety or an
external side-effect outcome; those are represented separately.

oneOf.description: Input binding, schema validation, or typed decoding failed before tool code ran.
The typed tool implementation ran and returned or raised a failure.
A nominal success failed output serialization, schema, or result validation.

ToolErrorProvenance.description: Stable invocation and tool identity attached to a failed tool attempt.

ToolExternalEffect.description:
Best available evidence about externally observable write effects.

This is not inferred from HTTP status, transport closure, timeout, or
cancellation. `Applied` and `NotApplied` require authoritative adapter/tool
evidence. `Unknown` means reconciliation is mandatory before retry or
compensation. Read-only tools always use `NotApplicable`.

oneOf.description: The tool is read-only, so write-effect evidence does not apply.
Tool implementation code was not invoked.
Authoritative evidence proves that the intended write was not applied.
Authoritative evidence proves that the intended write was applied.
The intended write may or may not have been applied.
